objective: Produce a bounded, deterministic, read-only report of which recorded claims cite evidence since found invalid, without rewriting history or granting deletion authority.
decision_supported: Can the system answer which conclusions must be reopened when one frame turns out invalid? Not from a flat reference set; the dependency is derivable from the log and is now computed.
acceptance: An invalid reference names every recorded event that cited it.
The report is deterministic: sorted inputs and outputs.
The projection never modifies the log or the event store.
An empty invalid set reports a computed empty result, not a missing one.
stop_conditions: The change would need deletion or rewrite authority.
risks_and_fallbacks: The projection replays the whole log, so it is O(events); that is the same cost as the existing audit.
